credentialsInfo:
The adapter signs in with an application of your own in the Home Connect Developer Program — free of charge, set up once:
1. Create a developer account (first button). As “Default Home Connect Account for Testing” enter the e-mail address of your Home Connect app account — exactly as in the app, in lower case.
2. Register an application (second button): Application ID any name, OAuth Flow “Device Flow” (it cannot be changed later), Success Redirect empty, One Time Token Mode off.
3. Wait 15 to 60 minutes — a new or edited application only becomes active at Home Connect after that.
4. Copy the Client ID (64 characters) and the Client Secret into the fields below and save.
5. A sign-in link appears further down: open it, sign in with your Home Connect account and confirm.
Coming from the old adapter? The Client ID was carried over. Only the Client Secret is stored encrypted.
aboutInfo: If you find this adapter useful, a small contribution is always appreciated.
